question: Can the interruption be identified from three fixed viewpoints?
method: Render a deterministic SVG preview from the production plan and inspect the composition from three fixed viewpoints.
inputs: Selected hypothesis composition and production-plan placement
constraints: Do not include identifiable people in the rendered preview

tasks.title: Read production-plan geometry
tasks.completion_condition: All required dimensions, materials, quantity, and unit values are resolved from the production plan.

tasks.title: Render the deterministic SVG preview
tasks.completion_condition: An SVG image preview with the plan values and three fixed viewpoints is written to the declared output.
